title: OpenAgentRule
description: Open Agent Rules (OAR) rule document. An OAR rule is an Anchor Binding with effect block|transform (or OAR Decision refinements warn|nudge|allow) plus hint copy fields. Normative spec: https://openagentrules.org/spec/1.1/. Does not redefine on/selector — those come from the Binding grammar. The document world is closed: any key neither branch declares is rejected, except x- extensions ([OAR-DOC-20]).

spec_version.description: OAR spec version this document targets. This engine accepts "1.0" and "1.1"; an unsupported major fails closed at load ([OAR-DOC-3]).

id.description: Stable rule id — equals the hints/<CODE>.yaml directory/file stem (SCREAMING_SNAKE).

namespace.description: Publisher scope. Rule identity is (namespace, id); absent means the loading host's own scope. The rendered Code: line stays the bare id ([OAR-DOC-21], [OAR-DOC-22]).

code.description: Deprecated alias of id. Accepted only when spec_version is "1.0"; rejected at 1.1 and later ([OAR-DOC-25]).

kind.description: Formal tier. Ordering on Emit: schema → policy → invariant → detector, then id lexical.

severity.description: UI/telemetry severity only. Never affects selection, evaluation, ordering, precedence, or the returned decision ([OAR-DOC-7]).

effect.description: OAR Decision effect. Binding bus effect remains inform|block|transform; warn|nudge|allow refine block-class Decisions. transform mutates content in place (content-safety series).

enforcement.description: monitor evaluates + telemetry only — never acts (no block/nudge/transform/on_fire).

mandatory.description: When true, cannot be disabled by overlay/pack/caller.

on_error.description: fail_closed | fail_open | <CODE> when a fact provider or detector errors.

on_fire.description: Closed vocabulary of engine side-effects run when the rule fires. CEL never mutates state.

flow.description: Optional multi-step sequence (Invariant-style ->) over recent ToolCall/Message.

stream.description: Streaming evaluation mode for output/tool_result Anchors. Default buffered.

emit.description: Provenance channel (guard:*, rule:*). Kept from hint.yaml.

tools.description: Deprecated top-level tool filter — prefer selector.tools. Still accepted and treated as selector.tools when that is absent ([OAR-DOC-19]).

requires_facts.description: Facts this rule needs. A host that does not provide one rejects the rule at load, naming both ([OAR-PROF-6]).

profile.description: Informational record of the author's intent. Carries no behaviour — portability is determined by the anchor and the facts ([OAR-DOC-24]).

onFireAction.description: Closed on_fire vocabulary. Schema is SSOT — do not hand-maintain a parallel Go AllOnFire list (Track 190 polarity). Optional thin Go consts only as sugar with schema⊇const drift.

owasp_llm.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 tags (e.g. LLM01). Telemetry/docs only.

mitre_atlas.description: MITRE ATLAS technique tags. Telemetry/docs only.

detector.description: Present iff kind is detector. Condition delegated to the detector seam.

^x-.description: Implementation extension. Ignored by other implementations ([OAR-DOC-20]).
